svg.aria-label: Markets, the developer stock exchange: Typescript +1.4%; React / Next +0.7%; Node / Apis +0.7%; Postgres / Sql +0.5%; Ai / Ml +1.5%; Kotlin / Compose +4.8%; Jquery (Legacy) -6.6%. And the practice: Full-stack, end-to-end. From schema to pixel. I design the data model, build the API, wire the frontend, and stay through the on-call. PMs get estimates that hold; users get features that don't flake. AI features that actually ship. X-ray analysis, transcription, document auto-fill, RAG. I make the model useful inside a real product — with guardrails, evals, and a sane fallback for when it's confidently wrong. The un-glamorous core. RBAC, multi-tenancy, WebSockets, PDF pipelines, migrations. The parts nobody demos but everybody depends on at 2 a.m. My natural habitat.
